summary:
Suburban McMansion on a 44x32 cul-de-sac lot: an 18-wide three-car garage wing with a bonus room, and a 26x22 two-storey main block with a 10-wide entry gable, portico and turret bay. Deepslate-tile roofs (hips with flat decks, ridge y14), stone veneer under birch siding, quartz trim and quoins, iron shutters, a chimney, driveway, lawn with shrubs and tree, and a back deck.
No code was run beyond block-id checks; design files are elements.md and plan.md.
